lines: Where many come and many go,
My wistful soul will oft cry out
For one who stays, who changes not.
The years pass on, a shifting train,
How sweet, how comforting the tho't,
That one remains who changes not.
As it has been, so will it be
Till comes life's final hour for me,
Mine surely is a favored lot -
I have a Friend who changes not.
He changes not, Christ changes not!
Though I should be by all forgot,
He still remains and will remain!
My precious Lord who changes not.
